RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday,  the November  23, 2005/Agrahayana 2, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Commerce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs; Non-
Conventional Energy Sources; Power; Rural Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions — 20
Demand for greater Nagaland
*1. SHRI MANOJ BHATTACHARYA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether there has been a persistent
demand on the part of Naga leaders for the
formation of a greater Nagaland with parts
of the territories from Manipur, Arunachal
Pradesh and Assam and if so, the details
thereof and Government’s reaction thereto;
(b) whether there has also been a demand
for a separate State comprising of the Garo
Hills, if so, details thereof; and
(c) the steps proposed to be taken by
Government to address the problems of
the tribal people in the North-Eastern
Region so as to retain them as citizens of
the Indian Union with equality and dignity?
Bomb blasts in Delhi
*2. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI :
SHRI S. ANBALAGAN :
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state :
(a) the number of persons killed and
injured in serial blasts in the Capital on the
29th October, 2005;
(b) how much compensation has been
given to each of the affected person and the
steps taken for their rehabilitation; and
(c) whether Government have since
identified the organization behind this
dastardly act and if so, the details and action
taken to arrest them?
State Police Acts
*3. SHRI SANTARAM LAXMAN
NAIK : Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state :
(a) the number of States which have
enacted State Police Acts;
(b) whether the State of Goa or the
Government of erstwhile Government of
the Union Territory of Goa, Daman and
Diu had sent any draft legislation of Goa
Police Bill; and
(c) if so, the details of the same ?
Emphasis on hydro power in new
power policy
*4. SHRIMATI SUKHBUNS KAUR:
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the new power policy

2
contemplates a shift in the emphasis from
thermal to hydro power;
(b) whether the actual achievement of
hydro power capacity addition was dismal
being only 1,435 MW against a target of
capacity addition of 2,585 MW during
2004-05; if so, what were the main reasons
for the sluggish performance;
(c) since Punjab, J&K, Himachal
Pradesh, Uttaranchal and North East Region
hold rich promise for hydro power; what
special efforts were made to augment hydro
power in these areas; and
(d) what special efforts were made and
incentives offered to attract private sector
investments in hydro-electric projects and
with what results?
National Identity Cards
*5.  SHRI    KARNENDU
BHATTACHARJEE :
SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI :
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state :
(a) whether there is any time bound
programme envisaged for issuing National
Identity Cards to all citizens in the country;
(b) if so, the criteria of citizens to be
covered under the scheme;
(c) the amount involved to implement
such a scheme on a massive scale; and
(d) how would it help the security of
the country?
Indo-US joint exercise at Kalaikunda,
West Bengal
*6.  SHRI S.S. AHLUWALIA : Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state :
(a) whether a  joint exercise by Indian
and the US Air Force has been conducted
at Kalaikunda in West Bengal since
7th November, 2005;
(b) if so, the broad details of the purpose
of the exercise;
(c) the year-wise details of joint military
exercises conducted by Indian Defence
Forces with those of friendly countries both
in India and overseas during last three years;
and
(d) the details of the primary benefits
presumed to be accruing to the Indian
Defence Forces by dint of such joint
exercises?
Rural Electrification Programme
†*7. DR. PRABHA THAKUR : Will
the Minister of POWER be pleased to
 state :
(a) the details of schemes formulated
by Government for implementing rural
electrification programme on priority basis;
(b) whether the rural electrification
programme is being implemented in remote
areas in many States particularly in the
bordering villages in each District/Tehsil at
a very slow pace;
(c) if so, the steps taken by Government
to expedite the said programme in bordering
villages; and
(d) the details of minimum standard
prescribed for the electrification of the
bordering villages?
Export of black pepper
†*8.  PROF. R.B.S. VARMA :
SHRI PY ARELAL
 KHANDELWAL :
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state :
(a) whether it is a fact that black pepper
is exported to many countries from India;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

3
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the details of export of black pepper
from India during last three years; and
(d) the amount of foreign currency
earned by the country from the export of
black pepper during this period ?
New Commission to look into Centre-
State relations
*9. DR. KARAN SINGH :
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY :
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state :
(a) whether Government are considering
to have a new Commission to deal with the
issues concerning Centre-State relations;
(b) if so, to what extent this Commission
will be different than the earlier one;
(c) what are the number of issues that
will be considered by this Commission;
(d) by when this Commission is likely
to be formed; and
(e) by when it is likely to submit its
report?
Shortage of power
*10. SHRI DHARAM PAL
SABHARWAL : Will the Minister of
POWER be pleased to state :
(a) whether it is a fact that there is acute
shortage of power in the country and
Government have failed to achieve the target
of supplying adequate power to various
States;
(b) if so, the details thereof and reasons
therefor; and
(c) whether Government are considering
strengthening the NTPC for generation of
more power in various parts of the country
and if not,  the reasons therefor?
Recovery of shells in
Garhmukteshwar
*11. SHRI R.K. ANAND: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that shells had
been recovered from the Ganga at
Garhmukteshwar; and
(b) whether it is also a fact that a
magisterial probe was ordered into the
Bhushan Steel Blast Case?
World Bank assistance for Bharat
Nirman Scheme
*12. SHRI R.P. GOENKA: Will the
Minister of RURAL DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that recently the
World Bank has been approached for
assistance to part-finance the Bharat Nirman
project aimed at scaling up the rural
infrastructure in irrigation, roads, water
supply, housing, rural electrification, rural
connectivity etc.; and
(b) if so, the details of the proposals
made and commitments received, if any,
from the World Bank?
Assistance to farmers affected by
floods in Uttaranchal
*13. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) the steps taken by Government to
provide assistance to the farmers affected
by devastating floods and land-slides in
Uttaranchal;
(b) the extent of loss of agriculture and
forest trees, etc. in the State by the floods
and land-slides this year; and
(c) whether Government have provided
full relief assistance demanded by the State
Government for facing this calamity?

4
Aid provided to earthquake affected
people of Pakistan
*14. SHRI V. NARAYANASAMY:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that India and
Pakistan have agreed to open 5 points in
the Indo-Pak Border to assist the
earthquake affected people of Pakistan near
Muzaffarabad; and
(b) if so, what is the total quantity of
aid which has been provided by the
Government of India to the earthquake
affected people of Pakistan?
Raising of battalions of CRPF
*15. SHRI PYARIMOHAN
MOHAPATRA: Will the Minister of
HOME AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have a programme for raising 60 battalions
of CRPF in the near future;
(b) if so, in view of the Maoist-Leninist
incursion into  northern and central Orissa,
is it being contemplated to open at least
one Group CRPF Centre in Orissa; and
(c) whether considering the availability
of infrastructure at the defunct FCI Talcher
and its strategic location next door to the
activities of Maoist-Leninist, will
Government consider opening a Group
CRPF Centre by raising 3 additional
battalions in Orissa at that place?
National Rural Health Mission
†*16. SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA:
SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the State-wise number of villages
where the National Rural Health Mission
scheme has been implemented alongwith
the date of its enforcement;
(b) the number of villages where female
Accredited Social Health Activists have been
appointed;
(c) the special measures taken by
Government to ensure the presence of
doctors on duty in village hospitals and the
availability of medicines to women; and
(d) the arrangements made by
Government for the monitoring of the
National Rural Health Mission?
Promotion of textile exports
*17. PROF. M.M. AGARWAL: Will
the Minister of TEXTILES be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government have given any
incentives to the textile sector to promote
exports during the last three years;
(b) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor; and
(c) the details of value of exports made
by the country during this period?
Promotion of non-conventional
energy sources
*18. SHRI MOTIUR RAHMAN:
MAULANA OBAIDULLAH
 KHAN AZMI:
Will the Minister of NON-
CONVENTIONAL ENERGY SOURCES
be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the schemes for
promotion of non-conventional energy
sources in the country;
(b) what is the role of the Central
Government and the State Governments in
their promotion;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

5
(c) what incentives are being given to
end users; and
(d) what were the targets for the Tenth
Plan and what are the achievements and
shortfalls?
NHRC's recommendations on
post-quake measures in J&K
*19. SHRI T.S. BAJWA: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether National Human Rights
Commission has made a series of
recommendations to the Centre on post-
quake measures in Jammu and Kashmir; and
(b) if so, the details thereof ?
Electricity-deficient/surplus States
*20. MAULANA OBAIDULLAH
KHAN AZMI:
SHRI MOTIUR RAHMAN:
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased
to state:
(a) the details of electricity-deficient and
electricity-surplus States;
(b) the tariff of electricity in various
States, State-wise/UT-wise;
(c) what is the total demand of
electricity in the country and what is its
availability at present; and
(d) the schemes to meet the electricity
requirements?

Vishesh Krishi Upaj Yojana benefits
for cashew exports
1. SHRI C. PERUMAL: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Cashew Export Promotion
Council has requested to allow Vishesh
Krishi Upaj Yojana benefits for cashew
exports without imposing any restriction
from April, 2004; and
(b) if so, the reaction thereto?
FDI in retail sector
2. SHRI C. RAMACHANDRAIAH:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is considering
to allow FDI in the retail sector in the
country;
(b) the details of investment made by
the domestic private sector in the retail
industry in the last two years;
(c) whether Government have assessed
the impact of this capital investment by
the private sector in the retail market in
India;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) whether Government is considering
to bring about changes in various existing
laws such as land acquisition etc. for
facilitating faster growth of the retail sector
in the country; and
(f) if so, the details thereof?
Decrease in exports of I.T. and
electronics
3. SHRI C. PERUMAL: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether exports of Information
Technology and electronics has decreased
by 14.52 per cent in the year 2004-05;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) the steps taken to increase the
exports?
Cancellation of export licences of
adulterated chilli exporters
4. SHRI B.J. PANDA: Will the Minister
of COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have cancelled export licences of four
exporters over the issue of Sudan dye-

2
adulterated chilli finding its way to market
abroad;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) what is the action plan of
Government to guard against such acts of
adulteration which bring a bad name to our
country?
Trade target
5. SHRI B.J. PANDA: Will the Minister
of COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that India has set
a trade target of $ 500 bl. by 2008-09, as
against the last year of $ 185;
(b) what is the export target for the
current fiscal; and
(c) what is the action plan of
Government to achieve the above target?
Subsidy for export of spices
6. SHRI A. VIJAYARAGHAVAN: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether there were any proposals
for providing subsidies for export of spices
especially pepper and cardamom, during
the year 2005;
(b) if so, the steps taken and factors
considered to take the decision in detail
category wise;
(c) the quantity of spices especially
pepper and cardamom exported under
various provisions, provision-wise,
category-wise for last three years,
year-wise; and
(d) the quantity of spices especially
pepper and cardamom imported under
various provisions for the last three years,
year-wise, provision-wise ?
Industrial licensing policy
7. SHRI N.R. GOVINDARAJAR: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have recently
reviewed the compulsory licensing policy;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the number of applications for
industrial licensing received/cleared for
compulsory licensing during the last three
years and the current year, State-wise; and
(d) the steps taken by Government for
quick clearance of applications for industrial
licensing?
Replacement of DEPB Scheme
8. SHRI TARIQ ANWAR: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
replace the existing Duty Exemption Pass
Book Scheme;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) Now the new scheme will be helpful
to common man?
Assistance to States under ASIDE
9. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the details of assistance available
under ASIDE scheme to States for
developing export infrastructure and related
activities;
(b) the budget allocation for this scheme
during the past three years together with
the actual amount spent each year;
(c) whether States have asked for more
assistance for developing export facilities/
infrastructure; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?

3
Hong Kong Ministerial Conference
10. SHRI PYARELAL
KHANDELWAL: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) what is India's stand at the Hong
Kong Ministerial Conference on agricultural
issues;
(b) whether developed countries are
ready to reduce their tariffs on agriculture
and also to reduce their subsidies on
agricultural products both in domestic
market and export market; and
(c) whether India will link the
agricultural issues with Non-Agricultural
Market Access (NAMA) issues?
SEZ in Andhra Pradesh
11. SHRI C. RAMACHANDRAIAH:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the details of proposals under
consideration for setting up Special
Economic Zones (SEZs), State-wise,
particularly Andhra Pradesh;
(b) how many of these units are product
specific with State-wise details;
(c) when are these units likely to be set
up; and
(d) what is the expected employment
generation in these units?
Special Purpose Vehicle for
infrastructure projects
12. SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is proposing
to float a new Special Purpose Vehicle for
funding infrastructure projects;
(b) if so, the details in this regard;
(c) whether any infrastructure projects
have been identified for funding by the
proposed SPV; and
(d) if so, the details thereof with financial
allocation made for each project and the
targeted date for their completion,
State-wise?
Enhancement of India-Pakistan trade
13. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO: Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that India and
Pakistan have agreed to enhance their
cooperation in trade and commerce;
(b) whether it is also a fact that Pakistan
has rejected to extend the list of importable
items from India which at present stands
at 70; and
(c) if so, the reasons therefor?
Production and export of Tea
†14. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the tea production during the current
fiscal year till date and how does it fare
with the last year;
(b) whether it is a fact that the export of
tea has declined in the current fiscal year;
(c) if so, the decline noted in tea-export
and the reasons therefor; and
(d) the steps Government are taking to
boost tea export?
Linking exports with generation of jobs
15. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has evolved a
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi

4
policy of linking increasing exports with
generation of jobs opportunities;
(b) if so, the main features and modus
operandi thereof; and
(c) the estimated number of persons
employed in connection with various
operations related to exports?
Import of edible oil
†16. SHRI SURENDRA LATH:
SHRI KRIPAL PARMAR:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are importing
huge quantity of edible oils;
(b) if so, the details of the import made
during each of the last three years and there-
after and the reasons therefor;
(c) whether Government are aware of
the fact that due to the import of huge
quantity of edible oils, the farmers are
forced to sell the oilseeds even below the
minimum support price; and
(d) if so, the precautionary steps being
taken by Government?
Export of services
17. SHRI S. ANBALAGAN: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the growth registered in the export
of services during each of the last three
years, sector-wise;
(b) whether India is still lagging behind
China, Korea and other countries in export
of services; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and the steps
being taken/proposed to be taken by the
Union Government to increase the export
of services?
Export of fruits and vegetables
†18. SHRI SURENDRA LATH:
SHRI KRIPAL PARMAR:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the State-wise details of export of
fruits and vegetables from concerned States
during last three years;
(b) whether Government have taken any
steps to augment the export of fruits and
vegetables from concerned States;
(c) whether the percentage of export of
fruits and vegetables from concerned States
is satisfactory in comparison to this
production;
(d) if so, the details thereof and what
balancing measures have been taken in this
regard; and
(e) the names of the countries to whom
export of fruits and vegetables is made and
the quantum of exports thereof?
Increase in import of agricultural
products
†19. SHRI KRIPAL PARMAR:
SHRI SURENDRA LATH:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that import of
agricultural products during last three years
has increased in each years;
(b) if so, the State-wise details thereof;
(c) whether Government propose to
reduce the import of agricultural products;
(d) if so, whether Government have
conducted any study regarding its far
reaching consequences on our domestic
agriculture and horticulture sector;
(e) if so, the details thereof; and
(f) the steps taken by Government in
this regard?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi

5
Export of iron-ore
†20. SHRIMATI     PREMA
CARIAPPA:
SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the number of countries making
attempts to get iron-ore from India;
(b) the names of raw-materials that can
be imported by India from the respective
countries;
(c) whether Government propose to
hold talks with such countries;
(d) if so, by when; and
(e) the names of countries to which
iron-ore is being exported at present
alongwith the quantum thereof ?
Preparation for WTO conference at
Hong kong
21. MAULANA OBAIDULLAH
KHAN AZMI:
SHRI MOTIUR RAHMAN:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) what preparations have been made
for the forthcoming WTO Ministerial
Conference to be held in Hong Kong;
(b) the countries which are supporting
India's stand in WTO; and
(c) the strategy being devised for
effectively putting forth the cause of the
developing countries?
Foreign Direct Investment in India
22. SHRI MOTIUR RAHMAN:
MAULANA OBAIDULLAH
KHAN AZMI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the present position of Foreign
Direct Investment in India, State-wise;
(b) the strategy devised/being devised
to see that the backward States also get
their due share in FDI; and
(c) the results achieved therefrom?
Funds for promotional and roductivity
enhancing schemes in Agriculture
23. SHRI MOOLCHAND MEENA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government intend to
allocate a total of Rs. 1,327 crore for various
promotional and productivity enhancing
schemes in agriculture, industry and mineral
sectors in the current fiscal;
(b) if so, to what extent these schemes
have been implemented;
(c) what are the total investment made
in agriculture and industry;
(d) to what extent these schemes have
been completed;
(e) whether the allocation of Rs. 500
crore has been provided to the States for
infrastructure assistance for developing
Agro Industries; and
(f) if so, what is the amount provided
to each State and how many States have
utilized this amount so far?
Embargo on Indian Traditional
medicines by some countries
24. SHRI K.B. KRISHNA MURTHY:
SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have taken
cognizance of the recent reports on embargo
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi

6
on Indian Traditional medicines by certain
countries;
(b) whether such an embargo is
permissible under the current multilateral
trade regime;
(c) if so, the details thereof; if not,
whether Government has taken up the issue
with concerned countries; and
(d) whether Government has issued any
advisory to the Indian entities?
Proposals of TERC
25. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Trade and Economic
Relations Committee (TERC) at its recent
meeting held in October, 2005, decided to
be more pro-active in increasing interaction
with neighbours, especially the less
developed economies;
(b) if so, the exports, imports and
balance of trade with respect to each of
these countries during 2002-03, 2003-04
and 2004-05; and
(c) the targets, if any, fixed for the
current year and the years to follow, with
respect to each of these less developed
economies, and the strategy and steps to
be taken in this regard?
Sainik schools
26. PROF. M.M. AGARWAL: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) the school-wise/State-wise details
of Sainik Schools functioning at present in
the various States of the country;
(b) whether Government proposes to
set up any new Sainik School in the country;
(c) if so, the location-wise details
thereof; and
(d) the details of criteria/guide lines fixed
for admission in these schools alongwith
the relaxation being provided to the various
categories?
India's share in purchase of arms
27. SHRI MANOJ BHATTACHARYA:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that during 2004,
India accounted for 15 per cent of global
weapon sales valued at $ 5.7 billion;
(b) if so, the details thereof and reasons
therefor; and
(c) whether Government is aware that
such heavy arms acquisition are likely to
send a wrong signal to the world community
about India's credentials and if so, the steps
proposed to be taken in this regard?
Modernisation of special forces of the
Army
28. SHRI THENNALA G.
BALAKRISHNA PILLAI: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) the year in which the plan for
modernization of the special forces of the
Army had been envisaged;
(b) whether the modernisation plan
could not be started till date;
(c) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(d) the steps taken to modernize the
special forces?
Appointment of Chief of Defence Staff
29. SHRIMATI SUKHBUNS KAUR:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) what decision, if any, has been taken
on the recommendation of the Kargil
committee for appointment of a Chief of

7
Defence Staff, for better integration of the
defence forces; and
(b) the reasons for delay in
implementing the same and the steps being
taken in that direction?
Instructions for making available
Defence helicopters
30. SHRI NANDI YELLAIAH: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government of Andhra
Pradesh has requested Union Government
to issue necessary instructions to the Flag
Officers (Eastern Naval Command),
Vishakhapatnam and Indian Air Force Base,
Hyderabad for making available Defence
